description: This PHP script initializes and configures a command-line application for the OrangeHRM system. It performs dependency checks, includes required files, registers multiple console commands related to development tools, and starts the application.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Symfony Console Application instance used to add commands and run the CLI application.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a command to the console application.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the console application, processing user input.
